title: Stand up the scanner project with the engine
description:
Purpose: Create DataParade-io/dataparade-scanner and move the deterministic scan engine into it.

Moves: ingest, analyzers, patterns/, classifier, data-flow, core pipeline structural path, graph mapping, matching unit tests.

Does not move in this epic: AI enrichment, CLI, upload, platform API.

Definition of done: the new project can scan a fixture repo programmatically and its unit tests pass.
